WITH
    cy AS (
        SELECT toYear(max(DateKey)) AS year
        FROM retail.FactSales
    ),
    py AS (
        SELECT year - 1 AS year
        FROM cy
    ),
    same_stores AS (
        SELECT StoreKey
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = (SELECT year FROM cy)
        INTERSECT
        SELECT StoreKey
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = (SELECT year FROM py)
    )
SELECT
    (
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = (SELECT year FROM cy) AND StoreKey IN same_stores)
        - sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = (SELECT year FROM py) AND StoreKey IN same_stores)
    ) * 100.0
    / nullIf(sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = (SELECT year FROM py) AND StoreKey IN same_stores), 0) AS same_store_sales_growth_pct
FROM retail.FactSales
